title: Authority Requirement
description: The shape a graph node uses to declare which authority scopes a claimed outcome touches, without naming a specific domain's scope vocabulary. Reuses the ontology's existing three-value required/preferred/prohibited constraint vocabulary (see docs/ontology.md, 'this same three-value constraint vocabulary ... is reused', and schemas/v1/evidence-requirement.schema.json for the sibling shape it mirrors).

scope.description: An open, illustrative authority scope, e.g. 'destructive', 'credential-access', 'billing', 'production-deploy', 'legal-compliance' -- not a fixed enum.
